uaf_cve_06.title: Realloc UAF — use old pointer after realloc
uaf_cve_06.pattern: new = realloc(old, sz); use(old); // old dangling if moved

uaf_cve_08.title: C++ delete UAF — vtable access after delete
uaf_cve_08.pattern: delete obj; obj->vfunc(); // virtual call on freed

uaf_cve_09.title: Global pointer UAF — global ptr freed, still referenced

uaf_cve_10.title: Error path UAF — cleanup frees, error handler uses

uaf_cve_11.title: Safe pattern — NULL assignment after free
uaf_cve_11.pattern: free(ptr); ptr = NULL; /* use after check */ if(ptr) use(ptr);
